'''Eldjo''' is a [[wikipedia:Landlocked_country|landlocked]] country located at the intersection of [[North Ayuma|North]], [[West Ayuma|West]], and [[South Ayuma]]. It is bordered by [[Darewa]] and [[Tonder]] to the north, [[Lycroa]] to the west, [[Praesyu]] to the southeast, and [[Urbiqu]] to the east. Eldjo is geographically divided among the [[Eldjan hills]], the [[Eldjan Plateau]], and the [[Lake Arn De Mon]] to the north; hills and forests cover most of the country's territory, whereas the majority of its [[List of countries and dependencies by population|5.3 million people]] are concentrated on the [[Eldjo river]] and its tributaries, which hosts many of the largest cities and economic centres, including [[Shorakim]], [[Suveto]], [[Xaipla]], [[Velsar]], and [[Jioquin]].

Eldjo is a [[wikipedia:federal|republic]] composed of 14 provinces, with [[Shorakim]] serving as the federal capital city and the seat of the national government. The country encompasses four principal linguistic and cultural regions—[[Eldjan language|Eldjan]], [[Lycroan language|Lycroan]], [[Fravala language|Fravala]], and [[Hadan language|Hadan]]—reflecting a long-standing tradition of [[wikipedia:Multilingualism|multilingualism]] and cultural pluralism. Eldjan's national identity nonetheless remains fairly cohesive, rooted in a shared historical background, common values such as federalism and direct democracy. Eldjan nationhood transcends language, ethnicity, and religion.

Eldjo originates from the [[Kingdom of Paher]], established in the Late Middle Ages as a defensive and commercial alliance; the formation of the [[Kingdom of Iceten]] in 1220 is considered the country's founding. The Kingdom had influence over the semi-autonomous areas within the [[Lycroan Kingdom]]. Eldjan's independence from the Lycroan Crown was formally recognized in 1504, creating the unified [[Kingdom of Eldjo]] in 1504. The confederation was among the first and few republics of the early modern period. Eldjo remained a network of [[self-governing provinces]] until 1534, when [[Seniaai Empire|Seniaai]] invaded and annexed the nation. Following the [[Seniaaii wars]], Eldjo became the [[Confederation of Eldjo]], officially abolishing the monarchy, but by 1593 faced growing division and conflict between liberal and conservative movements; this culminated in a new constitution in 1602 that established the current federal system and enshrined principles such as [[wikipedia:Individual_and_group_rights|individual rights]], separation of powers, and [[wikipedia:Bicameralism|parliamentary bicameralism]].

Eldjo has maintained a policy of armed neutrality since the 16th century, though invaded in the [[Red War,]] Eldjo never surrendered, leading its famous [[wikipedia:Guerrilla_warfare|guerrilla campaign]] against the [[Lycroan Union|Lycroans]]. Eldjo is the birthplace of the [[CEE]] and hosts the headquarters of many [[Ayuman organizations]]. Eldjo is a highly developed country, with the [[List of countries by GDP (PPP) per capita| 26th-highest gross domestic product]] (PPP) per capita. It performs highly on several international metrics, including economic competitiveness, democratic governance, and [[wikipedia:Freedom_of_the_press|press freedom]]. Eldjo has a longstanding advanced pharmaceutical and [[wikipedia:Biotechnology|biotechnology]] industry, and a strong tradition of [[wikipedia:Glassblowing|glassblowing]]. It is known for its [[wikipedia:Bread|breads]] and alcohol production, well-developed [[wikipedia:Tourism|tourism industry]], and growing startup sector.
